title: End-to-End Data Quality, Completeness, and Idempotency Gate
mission: Run full integrity checks across raw objects, database rows, coverage, units, timestamps, stations, members, variables, runs and eligibility before feature engineering.
steps: Detect missing cycles, variable gaps, member gaps, duplicate keys and impossible leads.
Validate physical ranges and units by variable/model.
Audit UTC/HKT semantics and target-date mapping.
Validate station/location coverage and date-effective metadata.
Block failed source families from downstream strict tasks.
acceptance: Any gaps explicitly represented, never silently imputed
failure: Critical failure blocks dependent feature tasks but not unrelated sources
